name: @dignetwork/dig-adapters-shared
description: Internal, unpublished workspace package holding the error taxonomy and deploy-result normalization shared byte-for-byte by @dignetwork/vite-plugin-dig and @dignetwork/next-plugin-dig, so the machine-readable DIG_ADAPTER_ERROR_CODES contract can never drift between the two adapters. Not published to npm — each adapter's tsup build inlines this package into its own dist.
author: DIG Network
